# Hand Gesture Whiteboard

> A real-time 3D gesture whiteboard built with Next.js, MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer, and Three.js. Draw colorful 3D balloon strokes in a physics-driven fish-tank scene using only your hands and a webcam — no mouse or touch required.

Live demo: https://cygra.github.io/hand-gesture-whiteboard/
Source: https://github.com/Cygra/hand-gesture-whiteboard

## What it does

- **Pinch to draw** — touch index fingertip to thumb tip (👌) to start drawing a 3D balloon stroke; release to drop it into the scene
- **Wave to create wind** — open-palm gesture (🖐️) generates directional wind that nudges balloons
- **Fist to clear** — hold a closed fist (✊) for 3 seconds to remove all balloons from the scene
- **Toggle theme** — hold Victory (✌️) or Thumbs Up (👍) for 3 seconds to switch between light and dark palettes
- **Color picker** — choose a stroke color from preset swatches, a custom color palette, or let the app pick a random color for each new stroke
- **Physics** — balloons float, drift, bounce off all six walls, and collide with each other
- **i18n** — interface available in English, Chinese (中文), and Japanese (日本語)
- **Privacy-first** — all processing happens entirely in the browser; no camera footage is uploaded or shared

## Tech stack

- Next.js 15 (static export, deployed to GitHub Pages)
- Three.js — TubeGeometry balloon rendering, custom physics loop
- MediaPipe tasks-vision Gesture Recognizer — real-time hand landmark and gesture detection
- NextUI — UI component library
- Tailwind CSS — utility-first styling

## Gesture reference

| Gesture | Action |
|---|---|
| 👌 Pinch (index + thumb) | Draw a 3D balloon stroke |
| 🖐️ Open palm wave | Create directional wind |
| ✊ Hold fist 3 s | Clear all balloons |
| ✌️ / 👍 Hold 3 s | Toggle light / dark theme |
